title: Though the Leaders on @huffpost aren't much better
summary: You either design for inclusion or you let culture of hate breed. Media needs to decide. It doesn't matter if a third party does the work. Your brand @foxnews anfd @huffpost labels these folks as leaders. You reward hate
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
You either design for inclusion or you let culture of hate breed. Media needs to decide. It doesn't matter if a third party does the work.

Your brand @foxnews anfd @huffpost labels these folks as leaders.

You reward hate
